## Objective and scope

Package the selected method with honest result states and a reproducible user workflow before the final candidate freeze.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Provide one versioned default policy, example commands, progress/cancellation, bounded attempts and deterministic replay metadata.
2. Distinguish convergence, coarse-only/stalled refinement, geometry rejection, resource exhaustion and affine fallback in typed results and diagnostics; no fallback counts as nonlinear success.
3. Add focused public API/CLI, map reload, cancellation and failure-path integration checks; shared numerical changes pass affected JVM/Scala.js suites.
4. Preserve canonical image/map/registration ownership and supported consumer contracts; do not grant SmoothIso to numerical inverse estimates.

## Planned areas

- modules/reframe4s-halfflow/
- benchmarks/flashalign/runner/
- docs/

## Blocking prerequisites

- G4 (`bd-01M4X4DX5Q6MBZCYTY4RQ85AHN`)

## Evidence and safeguards

Use Mote claims/path reservations when implementation begins. Preserve unrelated dirty work and immutable historical studies. Reuse canonical providers and current owners. Keep labels/evaluation-only masks out of fitting, tuning on qualification data, and runtime stopping. Record exact source/provider/input/config identities, commands, numerical tolerances and all failures; run affected JVM/Scala.js and independent numerical checks. Current geometry/export thresholds cannot be relaxed to improve a pass rate. Completed research may be negative; milestone/epic acceptance remains a separate evidence-based decision.
